projects.title: Metal Galaxy
projects.shortDescription: A plateform that aim to gather metal music ecosystem on one place.
projects.longDescription:
Metal Galaxy is a plateform that will regroup every member of the metal family in the same place. It goes from fans to bands including promoters.
The platform consist in 3 major features: a community driven encyclopedia, a live show agenda and a social network to connect fans and bands.

projects.title: FixPilot
projects.shortDescription: A platform to automate converations with service providers using ChatGPT.
projects.longDescription: FixPilot helps property managers to spend less time on handling emails and more to do their job. To achieve this goal, the platform read their incoming emails and take actions depending the intent but the human still have the last word in case of ambiguity.
achievements: Shipped MVP
Created architecture to handle long term vision
Implemented automated tests on critical features
Implemented CI/CD pipeline
Created Scaleway infrastructure

projects.title: Flowchase App

projects.longDescription: The register give exercises created by linguists to test and challenge students and give feedback based on the recorded audio. The feedback provided include corrections and tips to improve their speaking skills.
achievements: Stabilized the mobile application reducing the number of complaints by nearly 100%
Reduced infratructure cost by more than 50%
Implemeted bug reported tool to help support team

projects.title: Flowchase Teacher Portal
projects.shortDescription: A platform for teachers to create, manage classes, and track student progress.
projects.longDescription: The teacher portal allows teachers to create and manage classes monitor student progress but also to customize lessons given to a class.
achievements: Created a feature to automate classes creation totally removing the need for the support

projects.title: Flowchase Practice Tool
projects.shortDescription: A platform to allow anybody to improve themselves in english.
projects.longDescription: The Flowchase Practice tool is made to allow anyone to train their english skills with strong focus on speaking. The tool uses the Flawchase App's AI to give the same kind on feedback but applied to a text given by the user an not pre-created. In order to give as much help to the user, the tool also generate an audio (using ElevenLabs) sample to give the correct pronunciation.
achievements: Shipped MVP
Implemented CI/CD pipeline

description: Founded Metal Galaxy, a platform designed to unite the metal music community by connecting fans, bands, and promoters in one centralized ecosystem.
Led product vision, design, and full-stack development from concept to launch, building features including a community-driven encyclopedia, live show agenda, and social networking capabilities.
Led the development of an AI-powered platform that automates property manager communications with service providers using ChatGPT, significantly reducing email handling time.
Built complete infrastructure and architecture from scratch, implementing automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable cloud infrastructure on Scaleway to support long-term product vision.
Led development of an English learning platform consisting of a mobile app, teacher portal, and practice tool, leveraging AI to provide real-time feedback on speaking skills.
Stabilized mobile application reducing user complaints by nearly 100%, reduced infrastructure costs by over 50%, and automated class creation workflows eliminating manual support intervention.

Developed and maintained the Sayl ecosystem, a comprehensive suite of e-commerce and restaurant management solutions including Sayl Retail (Shopify alternative), Sayl Resto (online ordering), and innovative NFT/POAP wallet integration.

Implemented key features across web and mobile platforms including video call shopping, loyalty programs, custom layouts, and significantly improved performance (reducing load times from 10 seconds to 10 milliseconds in Store Manager).
Contributed to the development of Lychee OS, an operating system for 3D printers with integrated Lychee Slicer functionality, working with Go, C, and web technologies.

Implemented key features including print timelapse recording, recurring payment system with Mollie, and a web portal for seamless printer-to-slicer connectivity, while conducting R&D to optimize image rendering performance.
